subject: Bootstrapped confidence intervals - Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val)

messages.author: 7e03e1be4c50a5ec
messages.subject: Bootstrapped confidence intervals - Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val)
parts:
Dear unmarked community,

I know this is not directly an unmarked question but as it is (I believe) a commonly used function I hope it is appropriate to post here and see if anyone else has had similar experiences and hopefully, a solution.

I have been using the pcount function in unmarked (v. 012-2) to estimate abundance/density of a snake species, using transect length as an offset due to variability between sites. In order to estimate 95% confidence intervals of snake abundance associated with all transects, I have been using the Nhat function within a parametric bootstrap:

Nhat <- function(fm) { #function to estimate population size
  sum(bup(ranef(fm, K=50)))
}
set.seed(345)

(pb.N<-parboot(fm1z, Nhat, nsim=1000, report=3)) #use parboot and Nhat to get confidence intervals

One of the steps I have included is to compare the outputs of the different mixtures (P, NB and ZIP) in order to identify the most appropriate one. I have had no problem using this method for attaining confidence intervals for Poisson and NegBin models but am encountering issues when applying it to models with a Zero Inflated Poisson mixture. When I do, it generates the following error (in bold) which I have been unable to solve. I have tried this across multiple different ZIP models. Any help would be greatly appreciated:

> (pb.N<-parboot(fm1z, Nhat, nsim=1000, report=3)) #use parboot and Nhat to get confidence intervals
t0 = 49.48945
Running in parallel.  Bootstrapped statistics not reported.
Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) :
  3 nodes produced errors; first error: Hessian was not computed for this model.

As an example, one of the models I am trying to bootstrap confidence intervals for is as follows:
> fm1z

Call:
pcount(formula = ~1 ~ offset(log(Transect)), data = umf, K = 50,
    mixture = "ZIP")

Abundance:
 Estimate    SE      z P(>|z|)
   -0.285 0.596 -0.478   0.633

Detection:
 Estimate    SE     z P(>|z|)
    -1.83 0.633 -2.89 0.00386

Zero-inflation:
 Estimate    SE     z P(>|z|)
    -1.22 0.887 -1.38   0.169

AIC: 187.8672

The issue persists with the ZIP mixture with or without an offset, and with or without starting values in the model.

Kind regards,
Rob

messages.author: 7e03e1be4c50a5ec
messages.subject: Re: Bootstrapped confidence intervals - Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val)
parts:
I've managed to resolve this by installing an older version (v. 0.11-0) of unmarked.

Many thanks,

Rob
